name: efficiency-development-replay-20260924
purpose: Exact three-family exposed-development replay for output/timing parity of the LogisticRegression single-task joblib-pool overhead fix. Selection is independent of new confirmation; this is not a new accuracy or SOTA experiment.

replay_scope.reason_for_subset: The historical whole development manifest contains unrelated families whose current registry admission/exposure now differs after confirmation release. Keep that history intact and retain strict gates; validate only these three unchanged reviewed development entries.

expected_protocol.formula: 3 original development families * 3 folds * 1 seed * 2 methods * 1 learner
expected_protocol.scope: Output/timing parity only; no task, learner, source or feature-schema changes.

replay_scope.exposure_policy: Original entries are copied exactly; current registry normalization marks all three exposed/development. No rights, role or exposure widening and no confirmation access are granted.

rights.approval_basis: Reviewed original UCI publication's express data license; local development/stress benchmarking, not a curator badge alone.
rights.scope: Local processing and aggregate reporting. No hosted-LLM row sharing is approved.
rights.obligations: Retain original contributor/UCI attribution and disclose all curation, target and split limitations.

datasets.name: uci-german-credit
datasets.prediction_time: Credit application attributes predict good/bad credit risk; no outcomes are predictors.
datasets.evaluation_notes: Use repeated stratification for low-N development. Native class 1=good, 2=bad; numeric recoding is not a second family.

feature_descriptions.Attribute8: Installment rate as percent of disposable income
feature_descriptions.Attribute16: Number of existing credits at this bank
feature_descriptions.Attribute18: Number of people liable to provide maintenance for

nested_split_check.policy: 3-fold outer or all official folds; one tuning holdout, 3 stability holdouts, 3 screening folds and 2 residual folds; seed 2026. Structural feasibility only, no model evaluation.

admission_profile.prevalence_scope: Pinned source/curated distribution after documented target normalization, without catalog resampling. This is not an upstream population-rate claim; curator sampling/deduplication remains disclosed.
admission_profile.missingness_scope: Parsed missing values only. Original categorical placeholders such as Diabetes130US '?' and NULL codes may remain distinct source categories; curation notes disclose this.
admission_profile.duplicate_scope: Duplicate reviewed predictor vectors after declared exclusions, not proof of duplicate entities. No additional deduplication or row deletion was performed.
admission_profile.split_check_limitations: Structural reference check at seed 2026 only, not a guarantee for every learner/tuning seed or nested pipeline. No estimators, predictions or evaluation scores were computed.
